title: [15/07/2025] The process of recycling aluminum cans
prompt: The diagram below shows the stages in the recycling of aluminum drinks can. Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The diagram illustrates the process of recycling aluminum drinks cans, showing the various steps.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, the process consists of two main phases, beginning with the collection and recycling of used aluminum cans at specialized facilities and culminating in the manufacturing and distribution of new cans through beverage vending machines.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: The recycling process commences when used aluminum cans are deposited at collection centres, where they are stored in designated containers. These collected cans are subsequently transported by truck to a recycling centre, where they undergo initial processing. The processed aluminum is then delivered to an aluminum recycling plant, where the old aluminum materials are melted down in large furnaces to create raw aluminum material.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: Following the melting process, the recycled aluminum is formed into new aluminum ingots, which are processed through rolling machines to create thin aluminum sheets that are then used to manufacture new aluminum cans. The newly produced cans are then distributed to various locations and installed in drinks machines, where consumers can purchase beverages. Once consumed, the empty cans are discarded and collected again at collection centres, and the cyclical process then starts all over again.
